name: DynamicButter
description: Frame-accurate macros and the Dynamic click-window trainer.

macro-mode.name: Macro mode
macro-mode.description: Temporary control until the pause-menu UI exists. Record: records your inputs, and a text dump is written to the mod's save folder when you complete the level. Takes effect at the start of the next attempt.

show-tick-counter.name: Show tick counter
show-tick-counter.description: Shows the current physics tick (240 per second) in the top-left corner while playing.

log-inputs.name: Log inputs
log-inputs.description: Debug: logs every input GD applies, with its tick and player position.

tick-probe.name: Tick probe
tick-probe.description: Debug: logs once per second whether the tick counter advances exactly once per physics step.

force-disable-cbs.name: Force-disable Click Between Steps
force-disable-cbs.description: Debug: keeps Click Between Steps off while playing, without changing your saved GD setting. Recording always does this on its own.
